messages:
alex: Heads-up — Dan flagged a slip on the H100 replenishment. Vendor now estimating ~10-12 weeks due to a customs backlog and carrier capacity. We need an allocation + RMA buffer plan ASAP. @dan_nexasupply can you confirm which AWBs and whether split shipments are possible?
dan_nexasupply: Sorry about the hit — customs clearance at FRA got slower after the new HS audit. Current plan is to ship in two waves: provisional batch next week (small AWB for QA) then main batch. AWB preview: AWB: 123-4567890 (provisional). Full ETA 10-12w. We can expedite (FastAir) to cut to 4-6w BUT +$4k/unit and subject to slot availability. We can include a 5% buffer on the shipped qty for DOA.
priya: Can we request split shipments with larger top-off to avoid capacity gaps in EU? We need 64 GPUs for dedicated-prod in FRA region in 6 weeks to keep SLAs. Loaner ask: any chance for temporary loaner nodes (8 GPUs) while we await full delivery?
marco: Need RMA playbook if DOA > buffer. Who's the depot? Are they able to accept serial reconciliation on arrival? Our past issue was ~2% serial mismatch on manifests which delayed onboarding. Also what's vendor DOA historical rate?
dan_nexasupply: We can route RMAs to our FRA depot (contact: depot-eu@nexasupply.com, SLA 72h), or AMS if you prefer. Historical DOA ~1.8% on this SKU. We can add 5% buffer to outbound qty. Note on HS code for customs: HS:8471.80 — recommending attaching commercial invoice with model + serials to speed review. Expedited carrier is FastAir, tracking format FAST/#######. Split ship is OK but extra handling fee applies.
claire: Price check — if we approve expedite, how does PO amendment look? +$4k/unit changes cost center. Do we get any credit for buffer units or is that billed? We need an invoice preview before committing.
priya: Also ask vendor if they can reassign some allocation from APAC pool to EU to reduce lead time (we can exchange regional slots). Contract has a price-protection clause for 30 days — confirm if that applies to expedite pricing.
alex: Short-term mitigation: (1) borrow 32 GPUs from dedicated-nonprod pool for 2 weeks, (2) enable mixed-precision for high-throughput jobs to free ~12% capacity, (3) prioritize customer routes by route-policy. @ops-bot please open an ops ticket to track borrow + RMA follow-up.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-1423 — "H100 allocation slip + vendor RMA buffer & expedite decision". Assigned to infra/ops. Link: https://redwood.internal/INC-2026-1423
marco: For the infra runbook: commands to stage/drain and provisional provision: ```redwoodctl nodes drain --tag=dedicated-nonprod --count=4``` ```redwoodctl provision --sku=h100 --region=fra --qty=8 --priority=expedite``` Will also prepare serial reconciliation script to auto-compare AWB manifest vs depot manifest.
dan_nexasupply: Will send provisional AWB docs and a draft invoice for the expedite scenario by EOD tomorrow. Provisional ship: 12 units (for QA + partial top-off). Main batch schedule will follow after PO update. ETA example dates in draft: main batch now targeted mid-Jan 2025 in normal flow; expedite could hit late-Nov 2024.
claire: OK finance needs the draft invoice and confirmations on buffer billing model (consumed vs returnable). Priya, please confirm which cost center to charge for expedite.
priya: Charging expedite to infra/alpha budget for now. If vendor can reassign ~16 GPUs from APAC to EU that reduces our expedite need — Dan, can you check APAC surplus?
dan_nexasupply: Checking APAC availability now. Quick note: if we move allocation cross-region, customs re-documentation will add ~3 days admin + minor fee. Will update by EOD.
alex: Great. Let's reconvene after vendor update. If expedite looks too costly, we'll go with borrow + buffer plan and update customers. :thumbsup:
